title: Bengaluru North-South Twin Tunnel Road (B-SMILE: Hebbal to Silk Board)
tagline: 16.75 km twin-tube underground vehicular highway connecting Hebbal to Central Silk Board / St. John's. Tender floated for ₹17,698 Cr across two packages.

overview: Branded the Bengaluru Smart Mobility Infrastructure for Long-term Urban Equilibrium (B-SMILE), this ambitious 16.75-km twin-tube underground expressway is planned to connect Hebbal in the north to Central Silk Board / St. John's Hospital in the south. The project envisions two parallel 3-lane tunnels drilled at depths of 25 to 40 metres beneath the central business district. title: Second Bengaluru Commercial Airport (Site Selection & Feasibility)

overview: With Kempegowda International Airport (KIA) at Devanahalli projected to reach its peak capacity of 100 million passengers annually by the mid-2030s, the Karnataka government initiated formal steps to build a second commercial airport for the Bengaluru metropolitan region.
